makeLuaText.description: Creates a Lua Text object with styling options.

parameters.text: Text content to display. Defaults to empty string.
parameters.x: X position on screen. Defaults to 0.
parameters.y: Y position on screen. Defaults to 0.
parameters.size: Font size in pixels. Defaults to 16.

addLuaText.description: Adds a Lua Text to the scene.

parameters.inFront: If true, adds in front. Defaults to false (behind).

removeLuaText.description: Removes a Lua Text from the scene.

parameters.destroy: Whether to destroy entirely. Defaults to true.

setTextString.description: Sets the text content of a Lua Text object.

setTextSize.description: Sets the font size of a Lua Text.

setTextFont.description: Sets the font of a Lua Text.

parameters.font: Font name (must be available in system or assets).

luaTextExists.description: Returns whether a Lua Text with the given tag exists.

parameters.tag: Lua Text tag name to check.
